claims.head: Don’t buy Lankinen’s slump against the Oilers
claims.body: Lankinen has been shaky against the Oilers since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Edmonton: .851 save percentage · .894 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Lankinen’s record against the Oilers.
claims.call: If Lankinen starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .894 than to his .851 against the Oilers.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against Edmonton, 2,938 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Lankinen: .851 save percentage in 5 starts against Edmonton since 2023-24.
Lankinen: .894 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 2,938 shots.

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: The Canucks can’t afford to take penalties
claims.call: The Oilers’ power play creates at least their usual 9.8 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Oilers’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Canucks’ kill is near the bottom. The Canucks need to stay out of the box. Edmonton has had one of the league’s most effective power plays for years.
claims.nums: Edmonton 1st for power play (9.8 expected goals per 60) · Vancouver 27th for penalty kill

VAN.head: The Canucks have their work cut out
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks can still win it if their power play gets going, but a lot has to go their way.

EDM.head: The Oilers should be favored
EDM.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best way in is a power play that gets going.

story.head: McDavid’s favorite opponent
paras: The Canucks won the first meeting this season, 6-5 in overtime in Edmonton. The Oilers come in at 0-0-1, the Canucks at 1-0-0.
Don’t read much into Lankinen’s record against the Oilers. The Oil’s power play has a soft target in the Canucks’ kill.

items.text: Connor McDavid has a point in seven straight games against Vancouver, and 16 points in his last ten against them.
Brock Boeser has nine goals in eleven games against Edmonton since 2023-24.
The Oilers have been without Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Matt Savoie all season.
The Canucks have been without Thatcher Demko all season. Kevin Lankinen is expected to start.
